items.name: CAddVarBuilder::AddDefinedVar
items.role: Appends the hidden PEOD ints, after the system variables in PSYS, as KSSM is read.

items.name: SortVars
items.role: Orders the system variables so each comes after the ones it reads; otherwise stream order.

items.name: CAddVarSystem::Init
items.role: Evaluates every system variable once on the generator's own random. The candidate pairing of 0x278438 with 'Update' conflicts with the comment at port_remastered_effect_convert.cpp:2382, which pairs 0x278438 with Init. Also listed in the candidate list as "Update" (candidate 2).

items.name: CAddVarSystem::Update
items.role: Evaluates the system variables that are not init-only, at the emitter's frame.

items.name: CParticleGen::ShutdownEffect
items.role: With a SHTT the countdown is armed once; otherwise the shutdown acts at once. Also listed in the candidate list as "ShutdownEffect" (candidate 5).

items.name: GetCameraTransform
items.role: Its translation is the camera-to-world translation (the view matrix); CVECameraPositionInWorldSpace reads it.

items.name: CParticleGen::SetExternalDataSet
items.role: Takes the owner's external translation, rotation and scale (EXTT, EXTR, EXTS).

items.name: UpdateCountdownTimerForShutdown
items.role: Updates the shutdown countdown timer (SHTT, in ticks).

items.name: CParticleGen::DoShutdownBehavior
items.role: Applies the shutdown by SHTM: 0 stops emission, 1 also destroys live segments via CParticleSwoosh::DestroyParticles. Also listed in the candidate list as "DoShutdownBehavior" (candidate 11).

items.name: CreateNewParticle
items.role: Sets a new point's orientation from var bc, then applies PROT.

items.name: InternalUpdate
items.role: Reads each point's keyframes at its age, and KEWS at (age - base) / (count - 1) over the live points.

items.name: CParticleSwoosh::UpdateExisting
items.role: Re-evaluates live swoosh points each frame (PROT again unless initial-only); the gradient is read at a segment's age.

items.name: CParticleSwoosh::DestroyParticles
items.role: Empties the swoosh segment ring (index and live counts reset); retail's version is empty.

items.name: MPT_SetOrientation
items.role: Remastered's orientation setter; under XFMD 3 it writes the one system rotation (SetExternalRotation).

items.name: MPT_SetTranslation
items.role: Remastered's translation setter; under XFMD 3 it writes the one system translation (SetExternalTranslation 0x27b45c).

items.name: MPT_SetGlobalOrientation
items.role: Remastered's global orientation setter; under XFMD 4 it writes the external rotation (EXTR, var bc).

items.name: MPT_SetGlobalTranslation
items.role: Remastered's global translation setter; under XFMD 4 it also writes the external translation (EXTT).

items.name: MPT_GetTranslation
items.role: Remastered's translation getter; under XFMD 3 the getters read the one system variable too.

items.name: DestroyParticles
items.role: An electric's DestroyParticles, a no-op, so shutdown modes 0 and 1 both just stop emitting.

items.name: CParticleMath::CrossIntoMatrixRow
items.role: Cross product a x b scaled by the inverse square root of its squared length; false below kMinNormalizableMagSqd (2^-46). Also listed in the candidate list as "CrossIntoMatrixRow" (candidate 23).

items.name: SetupTransformMode
items.role: Sets the global frame (T, Q, S at desc +0xa8/+0xac/+0xb0) for XFMD: 2 identity with external scale, 3 external T/Q/S, 4 mover position and rotation at unit scale.

items.name: SetupTransformMode
items.role: Under XFMD 5 adds the generator's INTT as a constant CVEAdd (POFS) to the local translation over the scale. Also listed in the candidate list as "CVEAdd" (candidate 26).

items.name: SetupTransformMode
items.role: Computes the velocity step V12(f) - V12(f-1) (CVEVelocityCalc); 0 at the first frame.

items.name: CParticleDescription::Compile
items.role: Under XFMD != 5 the system scale is INTS when authored, else the external scale; the system translation and rotation take INTT/INTR when authored. Also listed in the candidate list as "Compile" (candidate 28).

items.name: SEmitter::CompileSystem
items.role: Compiles the constant-count vector path (CRCV); Compile1d runs only for a SEMR's position child.

items.name: SSpritePrim::Fixup
items.role: Under DVVN 1..4 a sprite's missing SIZE becomes 1.0, where retail's default is 0.1.

items.name: GetDefaultParticleSize
items.role: Default sprite SIZE used when a sprite lacks one under DVVN 1..4 (1.0 here, 0.1 in retail).

items.name: Fixup
items.role: PMRB and PMCF make the PMRQ the particle's base rotation; port-only PMRF selects 1 (PMRQ alone) or 2 (orientation times PMRQ).

items.name: CParticleVelocity::Compile
items.role: Remastered's DoesNodeFinalizePosition: a VEL source that finalizes the position replaces the generator's pos += vel step.

items.name: CSpawnSystemKeyframeData::Update
items.role: Evaluates each spawn table at the current frame.

items.name: GetNumInstances
items.role: Instance-count element (CIntElement) evaluated at the current frame.

items.name: CREDivide::GetValue
items.role: DIVD: a / b as a plain divide with no zero guard.

items.name: CRENegate
items.role: NEGT(x): returns -x; retail uses MULT(x, CNST -1), the same bit for bit.

items.name: CREAbsoluteValue::GetValue
items.role: ABS_: evaluates its child into a zeroed local, then takes the absolute value; the int form keeps INT_MIN. Also listed in the candidate list as "CREAbsoluteValue" (candidate 40).

items.name: CRERandomConstant
items.role: Leaf element for RAND of two CNST arguments.

items.name: CRELifetimeTween
items.role: Port-only PSLW blend from A to B by the system tween: a + tween * (b - a).

items.name: CREBlendByLifetimeConstant
items.role: Port-only PSLW blend with both children constant; same arithmetic as CRELifetimeTween.

items.name: CREKeyframeInput
items.role: KEYF version 2: 30-byte header, N keys and an input element; port-only PKYF. Other versions build no element in Remastered.

items.name: CREKeyframeInput::GetValue
items.role: Port-only PKYF: keys read at the input element's value, wrapped from the loop start when looping, blended linearly.

items.name: CREParentAdditionalValue::GetValue
items.role: Resolves parent reads: SPA* (parent system variable), DPV* (direct parent's PVAR), TPV* (topmost parent's variable).

items.name: MPT_CREExternalValue::GetValue
items.role: PMXV (MPXV): index then fallback; with an external block it reads vars[max(index,0) % 12], else the fallback. Also listed in the candidate list as "MPT_CREExternalValue" (candidate 48).

items.name: CREKeepInitial
items.role: KPIN: keeps its child's value at birth (CElementDep::Finish 0x24f9a4).

items.name: CRECosineWave::GetValue
items.role: COSE: amplitude * cos((phase + frequency * frame) in degrees); phase, then frequency, then amplitude. Also listed in the candidate list as "CRECosineWave" (candidate 51).

items.name: CRESolveUsingSystemTime
items.role: SUST: evaluates its child on the system's frame, the frame the port uses for swoosh elements. Also listed in the candidate list as "SUST" (candidate 52).

items.name: DistanceFromCameraBlend::CalculateBlendValue
items.role: Clamped ramp of depth along the camera's forward axis: 1 at A, 0 at B (DFCS or DFCP origin). Also listed in the candidate list as "Remastered" (candidate 54), "CalculateBlendValue" (candidate 56).

items.name: DFCP
items.role: Swoosh-side read: transforms a segment's position by the swoosh transform, for the camera-distance blend.

items.name: DFCS
items.role: Swoosh-side read of the swoosh's local translation by the swoosh transform. The candidate listed 0x299134 as DFCP, but CParticleGlobals.hpp:96 pairs 'DFCS/DFCP (0x299134 / 0x299064)', so DFCS is used.

items.name: CRERandomSign::GetValue
items.role: RSGN: the child, negated when the draw's bit is clear; one draw per evaluation. Also listed in the candidate list as "CRERandomSign" (candidate 60).

items.name: CREInitialRandomSign::GetValue
items.role: PIRS: one draw at frame 0 sets the particle's sign, kept in its slot; the result is that sign times the child.

items.name: CRETicksToSeconds::GetValue
items.role: T2S_: (float)(1/60 * n) for an int child n, narrowed once.

items.name: CREShutdownTimeRemaining
items.role: PSDT: the current system's shutdown countdown remaining over its total (SHTT); 1 when none is running.

items.name: CREKeepInitial
items.role: KPIN's initial-only flag (IsNodeInitialOnly) in the constant-after-start classification.

items.name: CRERandom::GetConstOverride
items.role: Returns false for RAND, so RAND(CNST, CNST) is not constant-after-start (per the PPVR flag test). Also listed in the candidate list as "CRERandom" (candidate 65).

items.name: CSwooshDescription::Compile
items.role: Start of Remastered's SIDE==2 ORNT swoosh ribbon, which replaces PROT with a rotation whose X is normalize(A x Z).

items.name: SetupOrientToView
items.role: Ribbon rotation toward the camera: A = camera minus point, Z = trail direction, X = normalize(A x Z).

items.name: CERotationKeepInitial
items.role: KPIN on a rotation: the keep is pushed onto each REUL angle, which becomes init-only hidden reals.

items.name: CERotationAdd::GetValue
items.role: RADD: quaternion product a * b of two rotations.

items.name: CERotationEuler::GetValue
items.role: REUL in axis order 0: Euler angles in degrees to a rotation (Rz * Ry * Rx). Also listed in the candidate list as "CERotationEuler" (candidate 72).

items.name: QuatGeneric
items.role: Euler (REUL, axis order 0) routine that the port's comment pairs with CERotationEuler::GetValue.

items.name: CERotationFromCamera
items.role: CMRT: the camera's rotation, one of the rotation kinds ROTV can carry.

items.name: CERotationFromAxis
items.role: RAZY rotation from two axes as GetRotationElement builds it: Z = first, X = second x Z, Y = Z x X; fallback when degenerate.

items.name: CERotationFromAxis::GetValue
items.role: RAZY rotation from two axes; false under kMinNormalizableMagSqd so the caller uses its fallback. Also listed in the candidate list as "CERotationFromAxis" (candidate 76).

items.name: CVEAbsoluteValue
items.role: ABS_ on a vector: the child evaluated into a zeroed local, then its absolute value.

items.name: CVEScale
items.role: SCLE(v, r): out = (v.x * r, r * v.y, r * v.z).

items.name: CVENormalizeVector::GetValue
items.role: NORM: the child scaled to unit length; unchanged when its length is at most 2^-23.

items.name: CVERandomVector::GetValue
items.role: RNDV: a cube point from the current RNG, scaled to the magnitude (1 when absent) by an ARM rsqrt estimate. Also listed in the candidate list as "CVERandomVector" (candidate 82).

items.name: MPT_CVECone::GetValue
items.role: MPCN: a point on the disc of the given radius (at most 1) around the position, perpendicular to the direction.

items.name: CVEAngleCone::GetValue
items.role: ANCR: a direction from a REUL rotation given as three angles, with the x/y ranges and magnitude. Also listed in the candidate list as "CVEAngleCone" (candidate 85).

items.name: CVEAngleConeMinMax::GetValue
items.role: ANCM: a direction between two cone angles, with the REUL rotation given as three angles. Also listed in the candidate list as "CVEAngleConeMinMax" (candidate 87).

items.name: MPAC
items.role: Angle cone of a centre and a spread per axis: five reals (x and y centre, x and y range, magnitude), drawing u for x and v for y.

items.name: CVERotateVector::GetValue
items.role: ROTV / PRTV: rotates a vector by EXTR, CMRT or REUL (axis order 0) in Remastered's particle space. Also listed in the candidate list as "CVERotateVector" (candidate 90).

items.name: CVECircle::GetValue
items.role: Circle point: wraps a before b = a + pi/2, then sums c + (r u) sin b + sin a (r v) per axis; u and v come from the constructor.

items.name: CVECircleWithVariance::GetValue
items.role: CRCV: a point on the circle around the centre; the ring is divided into n steps, in creation order or shuffled. Also listed in the candidate list as "GetValue" (candidate 93).

items.name: CVELineWithVariance::GetValue
items.role: LINV: a point along start..end divided into n steps, jittered by one draw; a segment under 1e-5 gives the start. Also listed in the candidate list as "GetValue" (candidate 95).

items.name: CVELineWithVariance::Compile
items.role: Compile step for LINV (PLWV); the shuffler and a constant 0 count are CRCV's, and Compile1d runs only for a SEMR's position.

items.name: CVECameraPositionInWorldSpace
items.role: CMPS: the camera position in world space (the view matrix's translation).

items.name: Compile
items.role: CPSS path: takes the world camera position into the system's translation, orientation and scale. The source does not name the class.

items.name: CVECameraPositionInSystemSpace::GetValue
items.role: CPSS: the camera position in the system's global frame, conj(q) * (camera - t) * q, then times the inverse scale. Also listed in the candidate list as "CVECameraPositionInSystemSpace" (candidate 99).

items.name: CVEBonePosition::GetValue
items.role: Bone-position vector element (BNPS); the comment calls it the bone index element.

items.name: CVEExternalValue
items.role: EXTT and EXTS: the external translation and scale, as system vectors.

items.name: CVENormalizedCompensatedVelocity::GetValue
items.role: PNCV: the particle's velocity normalised by one refined FRSQRTE step; up (0, 1, 0) when too small. Also listed in the candidate list as "PNCV" (candidate 103).

items.name: CVEVelocityCalc
items.role: EMRV: the translation one step back, for PRAZ.
